message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as the cover for Tempo magazine, dated August 23-29, 2021. The central figure is a large, smiling male caricature in a white shirt, raising his arms. His right hand covers his eyes. He wears a red-and-white ribbon medal on his chest. A group of five smaller caricatures—four men and one woman—stands behind him, also with arms raised toward a falling bouquet of red roses. These figures exhibit wide smiles and varied attire: white shirts, a red garment, a green suit with a black cap, and a yellow top.

The background is a textured dark purple with blurred light orbs. Large black letters spell "TEMPO" at the top. The bold white headline "MENDADAK CAPRES" appears at the bottom right, followed by several lines of smaller Indonesian text. Other text includes "PLN MERUGI, SIAPA PEDULI," "UANG SEMIR PROYEK MASJID SRIWIJAYA," and pricing details like "RP 45.000." A barcode and QR code are visible in the bottom left corner. The composition emphasizes a celebratory, upward-reaching motion among the figures.
